sources.title: Airports National Policy Statement
sources.role: Designated national policy statement for Heathrow expansion decisions
sources.facts: The 2018 statement provides the primary policy basis for a development consent application for a new north-west runway at Heathrow, subject to its current legal and review status.
sources.guard: A national policy statement is not a project consent, capacity allocation or proof that policy tests are met.

sources.title: Draft Heathrow Expansion National Policy Statement
sources.role: June 2026 draft policy under consultation and Parliamentary scrutiny
sources.facts: Published 18 June 2026; the draft would guide assessment of a future Heathrow northwest-runway DCO application if designated.
sources.guard: Draft consultation policy is not designated policy, planning permission, development consent or a delivery commitment.

sources.title: UK aviation forecast 2026
sources.role: DfT national aviation demand and emissions forecast
sources.facts: Published June 2026; provides forecasts for passengers, aircraft movements and CO2 emissions at UK airports for policy analysis.
sources.guard: Forecasts are modelled scenarios, not observed future demand, airport-specific capacity approval or a planning decision.

sources.title: CAP 2547: A guide to the Airspace Modernisation Strategy
sources.role: CAA guide to the Airspace Modernisation Strategy
sources.facts: Updated in April 2026; explains strategic objectives and enablers for UK airspace modernisation.
sources.guard: Strategy guidance does not approve an airspace change, establish a route, resolve noise effects or grant planning consent.

sources.title: CAP 738: Safeguarding of Aerodromes
sources.role: CAA guidance for aerodrome safeguarding assessments
sources.facts: Provides guidance on assessing how development, construction or obstacles may affect safe aerodrome operation.
sources.guard: Safeguarding guidance or consultation does not prove a proposal is safe, acceptable or approved by the aerodrome or planning authority.

sources.title: Control of development in airport public safety zones
sources.role: Government planning guidance for airport public safety zones
sources.facts: Sets out policy for development controls and land-use considerations in airport public safety zones.
sources.guard: A public-safety-zone policy or map does not prove parcel-level individual risk, prohibition, permission or compensation.

sources.title: Safeguarding aerodromes, technical sites and military explosives storage areas
sources.role: Government circular and direction material for official safeguarding consultation
sources.facts: Provides advice to local planning authorities on consultation arrangements for safeguarded aerodromes, technical sites and military explosives storage areas.
sources.guard: A consultation zone does not itself determine the planning application or prove an obstacle, radar, wildlife or explosive-safety effect.

sources.title: Airspace modernisation
sources.role: Government account of the airspace modernisation programme and masterplan
sources.facts: Describes the coordinated programme, CAA criteria and the UK Airspace Design Service arrangements.
sources.guard: A programme, masterplan or funding route does not establish that a specific airspace-change proposal is approved or delivered.
